python_interfaces.name: ProductLineRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Product Line is Customer-neutral reusable identity and repositories never commit internally

python_interfaces.name: ContractRepository
python_interfaces.rule: customer_org_id is immutable ordinary ownership; erroneous ownership correction requires dedicated pre-history correction guard rather than normal edit

python_interfaces.name: ContractProductLineRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Customer compatibility derives through Contract; reusable Product Line never owns SLA policy directly

python_interfaces.name: SlaPolicyRepository
python_interfaces.rule: policy revisions/tiers are immutable after acceptance; CPL current pointer may advance only through governed revision command

python_interfaces.name: SrClassificationRepository
python_interfaces.rule: one current valid classification at most; history is append-only and cross-customer assignment is rejected

python_interfaces.name: ClassificationMappingRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Beta 1.0 trusted automatic key is Customer Account Code; mapping never reads discarded Product text and multiple applicable mappings are ambiguous

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestSlaInputReader
python_interfaces.contract: returns immutable internal SR id, resolved Customer Organization id or unresolved, accepted Report Date or missing, accepted severity token or unresolved, accepted lifecycle/status projection including first effective Resolved/Closed endpoint and Cancelled state, cumulative accepted source-reported suspension as ExactDuration, active suspension facts/warnings inputs, and minimal source evidence refs. It never returns discarded Product as authority.

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-06; invoked by the future/current LLD-03 SR-Customer correction boundary
python_interfaces.rule: if current CPL's Contract is incompatible with new resolved Customer, append classification invalidation in caller UoW; never silently selects a replacement CPL

python_interfaces.name: CustomerAccountCodeEvidenceReader
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-02 plus accepted SR source projection
python_interfaces.rule: used only as trusted configured mapping evidence after SR Customer resolution; mapping target still must belong to that Customer

python_interfaces.name: IndividualSlaCalculator
python_interfaces.contract: algorithms/individual-sla.json; pure read projection with exact arithmetic

python_interfaces.name: ReportSnapshotBuilder
python_interfaces.contract: algorithms/report-snapshot.json; one stable accepted-state snapshot supplies all represented members/calculations/policy/classification provenance

python_interfaces.name: ReportArtifactWriter
python_interfaces.rule: generation/verification occur outside writer transaction; verified SHA-256/size and snapshot hash are required before completed evidence publication

python_interfaces.name: ReportJobCoordinator
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-01 durable jobs + LLD-06 semantic handler
python_interfaces.rule: job payload contains bounded report attempt/scope refs, never whole domain snapshots

invariants: bounded to prevent integer overflow in reviewed arithmetic

rules: Report Date missing remains missing and uncalculable
Resolved/Closed endpoint is first accepted effective eligible terminal instant rather than recording/import time
Objective timezone never appears in this value object

cross_domain_rule: LLD-06 never parses raw Advanced Search rows and never changes SR lifecycle/Customer source facts. It consumes accepted typed projections and, where SR Customer changes make classification incompatible, participates in the caller's same UnitOfWork solely to invalidate classification authority while preserving history.
